categories.label: Performance
categories.description: Array operations, kernels, launches and synchronization, with everything compiled.

categories.label: Latency
categories.description: Time to precompile and import the package, to compile a first kernel, and to launch a precompiled one, each in a fresh Julia process.

notes.label: Median → minimum
notes.description: The benchmarks report the minimum over their samples instead of the median, which is less sensitive to scheduler jitter. Earlier runs only recorded the median, these only the minimum; the dashboard shows them as separate metrics.

notes.label: Launch evals pinned
notes.description: The launch benchmarks use a fixed number of evaluations per sample. With more than the 64 command buffers the queue keeps in flight, they had been measuring waits on the GPU.
